test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true about a solution?

options.text: A solution is a homogeneous mixture.
Particles of the solution can be seen by the naked eye.
The solute particles do not settle down when left undisturbed.
The solute particles cannot be separated by filtration.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Particles of the solution can be seen by the naked eye.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• A solution is defined as a homogeneous mixture of two or more substances.
 
• In a solution, the solute is uniformly distributed within the solvent.
 
• The particles of a solution are of molecular size, usually less than 1 nanometer, making them invisible to the naked eye.
 
• Solute particles in a solution do not settle down when left undisturbed, ensuring the mixture remains stable over time.
 
• Solute particles cannot be separated from the solvent by ordinary filtration methods.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Homogeneous Mixture:**

 
 
• A mixture in which the composition is uniform throughout the sample.
 
• Examples include saltwater, air, and alloys.
 
 
 
• **Solvent:**
 
 
• The substance in which the solute dissolves, typically present in a greater amount.
 
• Common solvents include water, ethanol, and benzene.
 
 
 
• **Solute:**
 
 
• The substance that is dissolved in the solvent.
 
• Examples include salt in saltwater or sugar in sugar water.
 
 
 
• **Tyndall Effect:**
 
 
• The scattering of light by particles in a colloid or in very fine suspensions.
 
• True solutions do not exhibit the Tyndall effect, as the particles are too small to scatter light.
